## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      1 avis récent mentionne bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 août 2026 - 10 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Garlicks_, 10 août 2026, 3/5: "As a lot of reviews have already stated, it’s a really good app and so well thought out. I look forward to using it each day. That said, in the last month or so, the app is quite buggy, and as a fairly new user still, I do have a few gripes: - Recently, it takes a lot longer to open and start up the app - I would love to be able to download workouts to use without internet connection - It would be great if workouts could run in the background/ with the phone screen off - After completion of a recent challenge yesterday (29th June), this congratulatory banner kept appearing, and the only way to get rid of it was to join a new challenge. And now, I cannot find a way to exit that challenge I didn’t even want to sign up to. The chatbot instructions do not help, the three menu dots it directs me to never appear Update 10th Aug 2026 After completing another program (which I signed up to because I could not navigate the app without doing so, and then could not find a way to remove myself from the program) it’s happened again! Congratulations screen > Options to continue with block 2, start block 1, or choose another program. No button to just go back to the Home Screen. Uninstalling and reinstalling the app does nothing. Incredibly frustrating! At this point, I want to cancel my membership because this is really irritating. The programs are good, I just don’t want to be forced to do them."
<!--/ir-theme-->
